Ms Vey — update on your heating-visit enquiry (NBL-029-01).

1. There is no confirmed appointment. Our property record shows no active work order and no appointment entry for this visit (note of 12 May 08:34; note of 13 May 08:29). Nobody has been authorised to attend on Wednesday 14 May or Saturday 17 May.

3. Please do not admit anyone who is not confirmed by us in writing beforehand, and your son is not expected to give anyone access. If someone attends without our written confirmation, you are not obliged to let them in.
4. Any genuine visit will be confirmed by us in advance, naming the engineer and the company, with a time window you have agreed. We have asked the contractor not to contact you directly and have not released your contact details to him.
5. Noted that the heating is working and the pressure loss has been intermittent over the past month, and that Saturday 17 May 10:00–12:00 could suit you. We have held that window as a preference only — it is not booked.

Please forward any further calls or texts from 07700 900683 to us rather than replying. If you ever feel unsafe or someone attempts entry, call the police on 101 (999 if urgent).
